name: CRITICAL WARNING: Sushi Bar Seaweed Salad (Wakame Algae Stricture Hazard)
whyItWorks: EMERGENCY CLINICAL OBSTRUCTION HAZARD: Wakame seaweed salad consists of thick, slippery, leathery strands of marine algae seasoned with sesame oil and whole sesame seeds. Human digestive enzymes cannot break down the structural alginates; in Crohn's disease with strictures or ileostomies, the long leathery ribbons ball up like tangled wet rope and cause acute surgical bowel obstruction.
prepOrOrderInstructions: NEVER consume green seaweed salad (wakame) if you have known intestinal narrowings or strictures. Choose clear dashi broth or edamame instead.
